summary: @or-sdk/billing preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package is advertised as a billing SDK but its `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (pinned v1.3.13), extracts it, marks it executable, and then uses that downloaded runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D})`). `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) file with heavy obfuscation: mangled identifiers such as `_0xNNNN`, `MmgoCP`, `WV8StW`, a large opaque numeric/string constant table `n7gIxM`, and a string-array rotation cipher (`push(shift())`). The file is not referenced from the library's TypeScript sources under `dist/` and only runs under the fetched Bun binary — bypassing Node-based tooling that would otherwise see the code path. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundled blob is unrelated to billing SDK functionality and matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern for install-time code execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
